{{Infobox academic|birth_date=1 April 1950|birth_place= [[Norrbotten County]] |death_date=19 April 2006|death_place= [[Stockholm]]|work_institutions=[[Luleå University of Technology]]|discipline=[[mathematics]]<br/>[[computer science]]|sub_discipline=[[mathematical logic]]|known_for=work on [[Gödel's incompleteness theorems]]<br/>contributions to [[Usenet]]|notable_works=''Gödel's Theorem: An Incomplete Guide to its Use and Abuse''}}
'''Torkel Franzén''' (1 April 1950, [[Norrbotten County]] – 19 April 2006, [[Stockholm]]) was a [[Sweden|Swedish]] academic.

==Biography==
Franzén worked at the Department of Computer Science and Electrical Engineering at [[Luleå University of Technology]], Sweden, in the fields of [[mathematical logic]] and [[computer science]]. He was known for his work on [[Gödel's incompleteness theorems]] and for his contributions to [[Usenet]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/publicoutreach/in-memory/inmemory-2006-2007 In Memory Of], web page at the [[American Mathematical Society]], accessed August 2, 2007.</ref> He was active in the online [[science fiction fandom|science fiction fan community]], and even issued his own electronic [[science fiction fanzine|fanzine]] ''Frotz'' on his fiftieth birthday.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sm.luth.se/~torkel/eget/frotz.html |title=Frotz: An Electronic Oneshot |accessdate=2007-10-01 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20071001011504/http://www.sm.luth.se/~torkel/eget/frotz.html |archivedate=October 1, 2007 }}, accessed online September 8, 2007.</ref>  He died of [[bone cancer]] at age 56.<ref>[http://groups.google.com/group/sci.logic/browse_frm/thread/8deb70503c02d63e/36847f81050c349d Torkel Franzén is dead], 20 April 2006.</ref>

== Selected works ==
* ''Gödel's Theorem: An Incomplete Guide to its Use and Abuse''. [[Wellesley, Massachusetts]]: [[A K Peters, Ltd.]], 2005. x + 172 pp. {{ISBN|1-56881-238-8}}.
* ''Inexhaustibility: A Non-Exhaustive Treatment''. [[Wellesley, Massachusetts]]: [[A K Peters, Ltd.]], 2004. Lecture Notes in Logic, #16, [[Association for Symbolic Logic]]. {{ISBN|1-56881-174-8}}.
* [http://www.ams.org/notices/200604/fea-franzen.pdf The Popular Impact of Gödel's Incompleteness Theorem], ''[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]'', '''53''', #4 (April 2006), pp.&nbsp;440&ndash;443.
* ''Provability and Truth'' (Acta universitatis stockholmiensis, Stockholm Studies in Philosophy 9) (1987) {{ISBN|91-22-01158-7}}
